geometry.registration: cell centres; north_lat/west_lon are the first row/column centres

dataset.name: Gale merged HiRISE DEM (Mars Trek Gale_DEM_SMG_1m), ~20 m export
dataset.processing_level: Mars Trek ImageServer export, bilinear resampling to ~20 m
limitations: Resampled from a 1 m DEM to ~20 m: features smaller than ~20 m are not represented.
Cells the export marks as no-data are never treated as flat; run tools/check_terrain.py to look for undeclared fill values.
Coverage and vertical datum must be verified by the data team before operational use.
lineage: source raster data/regions/gale/raw/dem/export_r0_c0.tif: 2005 x 1800 px, read with rasterio 1.5.2 (GDAL 3.12.2)

The file declares GCS_Mars_2000 (a=3396190 m, b=3376200 m, geographic). Its coordinate values are used unchanged as IAU_2015:49900 (planetocentric latitude), because: 1387 independent points (MSL_waypoints.json) agree with the DEM to a median 7.9 m (max 19 m) if its latitudes are planetocentric, versus 384.7 m (max 577 m) if planetographic (the conventions differ by 3.31 km here)
